name: How can a general contractor improve their AEO?

mainEntity.name: How can a general contractor improve their AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: General contractors can improve their AEO by creating high-quality, informative content about construction best practices, project planning, and industry trends. Showcasing detailed project case studies with before-and-after photos, client testimonials, and team bios highlights expertise. Obtaining positive reviews on industry-specific platforms and maintaining a strong online reputation also builds trust. Additionally, ensuring your website is technically sound, mobile-friendly, and secure contributes to a positive user experience, signaling reliability to search engines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve AEO by creating expert content, showcasing project case studies, collecting client testimonials, and maintaining a strong online reputation.
